login.expirou: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

esqueci.texto: Enter your email. If it is registered, you will receive a link to create a new password.
esqueci.enviado: If the email is registered, the link will arrive shortly. It is valid for 30 minutes.

definirSenha.dica: Use at least 8 characters. A phrase with a few words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
definirSenha.naoConfere: The two passwords do not match.
definirSenha.pronto: Password created. Sign in with your email and the new password.
definirSenha.invalido: This link is invalid or has expired.

usuarios.nomeExibicaoDica: The name shown across the system: tickets, tasks, hours, teams and menu.
usuarios.usuarioDica: To sign in, besides the email. Unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
usuarios.senhaInicialDica: At least 8 characters. The person changes it at first sign-in.
usuarios.linkTextoConvite: Email is not configured in the system yet. Copy the link and send it to the person another way. It is valid for 72 hours.
usuarios.linkTextoRedefinir: Email is not configured in the system yet. Copy the link and send it to the person another way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
usuarios.excluirAviso: The person can no longer sign in, leaves the list and the teams, and the email becomes free for a new user. Tickets and hours keep showing their name; their open tickets go to another assignee or to the team supervisor. This cannot be undone.
usuarios.gruposAviso: Each person's teams are set on the Teams screen.
usuarios.semEmail: No email registered. Add one to receive links by email.
usuarios.chamadosSemSupervisor: Tickets {lista} are still assigned to {nome}: the group has no supervisor to take them. Reassign them.

grupos.salveAntes: Save the team to add members.

trocarSenha.texto: You signed in with the default password. Before continuing, choose a password of your own.

vazio.watching: You are not watching any open ticket.

chamados.demaisParaMudar: Select at most {n} tickets at a time.

quadro.limite: Showing the {n} oldest tickets. Filter by assignee to see the others.

novoChamado.semGrupo: You are not a member of any team yet. Ask the administrator to add you to a team before creating tickets.
novoChamado.tituloDica: What needs to be done, in a few words.
novoChamado.tituloCurto: Enter a title with at least 3 letters.
novoChamado.descricaoDica: Details. Type the at sign and a name to mention a colleague.
novoChamado.inicioNoFuturo: The start cannot be in the future.

chamado.semAcesso: You don't have access to this ticket
chamado.semObservadores: No one is watching this ticket.
chamado.transferirTexto: The ticket goes to the other team, assigned to the person you choose. Your team can still see it but can no longer change it.
chamado.informeMotivo: Enter the reason for the transfer.
chamado.comentarioDica: Describe the task done. Type the at sign and a name to mention a colleague.
chamado.tempoInvalido: Enter valid hours and minutes, such as 01:30.
chamado.tempoSemTexto: Describe the task done in that time.
chamado.cancelarTexto: A canceled ticket cannot be reopened.

textoObrigatorio.reopen: Write in the task why it is being reopened.

chamado.mudou: The ticket changed since you opened it: check it and try again.
chamado.tarefaNova: A new task arrived while you were writing: check it and send again.

relatorios.periodoInvalido: The end date must be on or after the start date.
relatorios.expedienteUsado: Overtime is task time outside working hours: {expediente}, excluding holidays. A task ends at the date and time entered.
relatorios.mostrando: Tasks {de} to {ate} of {total}. The block CSV has all of them.
relatorios.listaCortada: Showing {n} of {total} tasks. The block CSV has all of them.
relatorios.filtrosSalvosInvalidos: Some filters saved in the template no longer apply to you and were left out: {filtros}.
relatorios.modeloInvalido: This template was saved in a format that is no longer valid. Edit it and save it again.
relatorios.verNumeros: See the numbers (without JavaScript they don't load on their own)
relatorios.acimaDe100: Above 100%: more tickets closed than opened.

editor.inicial: Open this template when entering Reports
editor.filtrosNovo: The period and filters on the screen go into the template. To change them later, adjust the screen and use Save filters.
editor.filtrosEditar: The template's period and filters are adjusted on the screen, with Save filters.
editor.maioresDica: Empty shows all; the rest goes into Others.
editor.excluirAviso: The template {nome} leaves your list. The numbers do not change: they come from the tickets.
editor.empilhadasAjuda: Shows the hours within working hours and the overtime, one on top of the other.
editor.clienteAjuda: The client report has the opening text, the totals, the tickets of the period and the notes, without overtime, teams or the text of the tasks. The blocks are kept for when the template goes back to internal.
editor.area: Fill the area under the line
editor.grande: Big number (with the change and the trend)
editor.filtroDoBlocoAjuda: Narrows the page's filter: with values in both, what they have in common applies; with none here, the page's applies.
editor.semOutros: Hide the Others row (the total still includes everything)
editor.descricaoDica: One sentence about what the template shows: it appears below the title, on screen and in the PDF, and as the tab tooltip.
editor.rodapeDica: Text on every page, above the generation date and the page number. Empty: just the date and the number.
editor.foraDoPdf: Leave out of the PDF (still on screen and in the CSV)

cliente.aberturaDica: Shown right below the client and the period. Empty: nothing.
cliente.observacoesDica: Shown at the end, after the ticket list. Empty: nothing.
cliente.semHoras: Hide the hours (the column and the total)

relatorios.tituloEmpilhado: Hours per {dimensao}: within working hours and overtime

cascata.dica: Hides from the client list the clients you already reported on today (PDF downloaded).

historico.explicacao: The Clients tab PDFs you downloaded with a single client. Generate again uses the same filters and period, with today's data.

chamados.cortada: The list shows the first {n}; the CSV has all of them.

paraCliente.umCliente: The client report needs a client, and just one, in the client filter.
paraCliente.previa: Preview of the report for {cliente}: the same text as the PDF, without its page breaks.

relatorios.filtroNaoCombina: This block's filter ({filtro}) doesn't match the page's.
relatorios.filtroDoBlocoInvalido: Parts of this block's filter no longer apply to you and were left out: {filtros}.

organizarAbas.ajuda: The order and the tabs shown in Reports apply only to you. A hidden tab still opens from a link. The default template is always shown.
organizarAbas.inicial: The default template is always shown.

descricoes.produtividade: Hours, overtime, tasks and closed tickets for each person.
descricoes.clientes: Hours and opened and closed tickets for each client.
descricoes.horasExtras: Task time outside working hours, by day and by person, and the tasks that had it.
descricoes.chamados: Opened, closed and open tickets, time to close, reopen rate and open tickets by age, status and team.

expediente.descricao: Working days and hours. Task time outside them shows up as overtime in the reports.
expediente.horarioInvalido: The end must be after the start.
expediente.intervaloDica: Outside working hours. Leave both empty for no break.
expediente.intervaloInvalido: The break needs a start and an end, within the working hours, with the end after the start.
expediente.feriadosDica: On these days all task time counts as overtime.
expediente.descricaoPaineis: Teams and people can have their own working hours, in each one's panel (Teams and Users). Holidays apply to everyone.
expediente.semProprioUsuario: No own working hours (follows the team's or the installation's)
expediente.semProprioGrupo: No own working hours (follows the installation's)
expediente.novaVigenciaDica: The days before it keep the previous working hours.
expediente.semDias: Check at least one working day.
expediente.conflito: In more than one team with working hours ({grupos}): set this person's own working hours. Until then, the installation's apply.
expediente.membrosSeguem0: No member follows the team's working hours today.
expediente.membrosSeguem1: 1 member follows the team's working hours today.
expediente.membrosSeguem2: {n} members follow the team's working hours today.

configuracoes.idiomaDica: Each person can choose another language in the user menu.
configuracoes.coresDescricao: Choose the company's three colors. The system adjusts shades where needed so buttons, links and text stay easy to read, in light and dark modes.
configuracoes.corNeutraDica: Secondary text and borders; base of dark mode.
configuracoes.logotipoDescricao: Shown at the top of the menu and on the sign-in screen. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 256 KB.
configuracoes.logotipoGrande: The image is larger than 256 KB.
configuracoes.logotipoTipo: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
configuracoes.predefinidasDica: Pick one to fill in the three colors; check the preview and save.

dataHora.ajustado: Set by hand. Now goes back to the current time.
dataHora.invalida: Enter a valid date and time.

statusConfig.descricao: Statuses appear in this order in lists and in the ticket form. The behavior tells the system what the status means and cannot change after it is created.

explicacoes.open: Open: the ticket is in the team queue and the work is to do or in progress.
explicacoes.waiting: On hold: the work is paused waiting for someone, such as the customer or a supplier.
explicacoes.delivered: Delivered: the work was delivered and awaits the supervisor review. Only the team supervisor or an admin can move the ticket to a closed status.
explicacoes.closed: Closed: the work is finished. Records the completion date and the ticket can be reopened.
explicacoes.canceled: Canceled: the ticket left the queues without the work being done.

statusConfig.unico: This is the only status with this behavior. Create another one before removing it.
statusConfig.removerComUm: The ticket with this status moves to {destino}.
statusConfig.removerComVarios: The {n} tickets with this status move to {destino}.

clientes.buscaDica: Name, trade name, CPF/CNPJ or e-mail.
clientes.mostrandoDe: Showing {n} of {total} clients. Refine the search to see the others.

erros.telefone: Enter the area code and the number.
erros.horas: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000.

anexos.arraste: or drop files here (up to 25 MB each)

tokens.explicacao: A token lets an integration or an AI assistant (such as Claude Code) use TicketFlow on your behalf, with your permissions. It cannot access administration. Revoke the ones you no longer use.
tokens.copieAgora: Copy the value now: it won't be shown again. Keep it like a password.
tokens.nomeDica: What it is for, e.g. Claude Code on my computer.
tokens.nenhum: You don't have any tokens yet.
tokens.comoUsarApi: In the API, send the token in the Authorization header:
tokens.comoUsarMcp: For an AI assistant, through the MCP server: in Claude Code, run this in a terminal (with the token in place of tf_…):
tokens.mcpOutros: In another MCP client, use the address {url} (Streamable HTTP) with the same Authorization header. With a read-only token, the assistant can look things up but not change anything.

tokensAdmin.explicacao: Everyone's active tokens, with their last use. Revoking cuts off access immediately. Each person creates their own in API tokens, in the user menu.
